$comment: Seeded by frontend/supabase/seed.sql, which supabase db reset applies automatically. These ids are stable and may be referenced literally by tests and gates — that is the point of publishing them here rather than scattering literals through test files. node scripts/check-seed-fixture.mjs fails the build when this file and the SQL disagree, in either direction, so an id can never be changed in one place only. Org Beta exists so a tenant-isolation test has a second tenant to be excluded from: ROADMAP Phase 11 requires proving a user in org A cannot read, write or enumerate org B's cases, PDFs or shared links, and a single-org fixture cannot express that.
